title: 我开源了一个 deepseek harness 插件，解决挂接 sglang/vllm 时，角色冲突的问题
content: A developer released an open-source plugin (dsh-localqwen-rolefix) that resolves a role conflict when connecting DeepSeek Harness with SGLang or vLLM. DeepSeek Harness changes the role to "developer" when inference strength is specified, but SGLang and vLLM only recognize "system" and "user" roles, causing 400 errors. The plugin preserves DeepSeek Harness's inference strength adjustment feature while enabling compatibility with SGLang and vLLM, allowing users to control thinking intensity while leveraging SGLang's fast prefill performance.

title: 471亿，全球最大的大模型中介，卖身了
content: Stripe is acquiring OpenRouter, the largest AI model routing platform, for over $7 billion, potentially setting a record for AI model routing M&A. Founded in 2023, OpenRouter serves 8 million developers by aggregating 400+ large language models through a single API, enabling cost comparison and failover capabilities. The platform processes an estimated 100 trillion tokens monthly and was valued at $1.3 billion in May 2025. Investors include a16z, CapitalG, and NVentures. The acquisition reflects growing enterprise demand to avoid vendor lock-in with single AI providers.

title: 刚刚，Claude水印一夜变废纸
content: A GitHub project called watermarks-remover has gained 11,000 stars for stripping AI watermarks from major models. The open-source tool removes Anthropic's statistical text watermarking in Claude, Google's SynthID-Text, and OpenAI's hidden markers through a three-layer approach: cleaning invisible Unicode characters, using agent-based rewriting with alternative models to destroy statistical patterns, and stripping C2PA/EXIF metadata from images and PDFs. It also includes pixel-level image regeneration and scientific verification via MarkLLM. The tool's popularity reflects backlash against Anthropic's global watermarking policy, implemented to comply with EU AI regulations without opt-out options for any users.

title: 别把全职工作当成唯一安全感
content: Relying solely on a full-time job for security is risky in today's economy, as layoffs can happen instantly without warning. There are four core income channels: salary, royalties/recurring revenue, rental income, and arbitrage. Building multiple income streams—even from one skill across different channels—reduces vulnerability. Not everyone should quit their job, but everyone should recognize employment is just one option among many, not the only path to stability.

title: 弄懂这 5 个AI术语，你就超过了90%的人
content: AI models process text in "tokens" (word fragments). The "context window" is the model's memory limit; when full, older content is forgotten. "Temperature" controls output randomness: low for factual tasks, high for creative ones. "Hallucination" occurs when AI confidently generates false information because it predicts plausible text rather than retrieving facts. "RAG" (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) lets AI answer questions using uploaded documents by retrieving relevant snippets first. Understanding these five concepts enables more effective, critical AI use.
